title: 龙洲经讯Tilly Zhang：反内卷效果有限，价格战仍在持续
speaker: Tilly Zhang

segments.en: Tilly, what does this mean for these companies? Now I'm just wondering we saw the sort of a negative reaction to all this news leading up to it.
segments.zh: Tilly，这对这些公司意味着什么？我们看到市场对这些消息有负面反应。

segments.en: Do these, you know, the scolding, even without punishment, do you think that helps or at least changes the operations of these companies? Do you think, how effective do you think it really is in terms of ending some of these price wars and the competition in these industries now?
segments.zh: 这种批评即使没有惩罚，是否有助于改变这些公司的运营？你认为在结束价格战和行业竞争方面效果如何？

segments.en: Well it's actually quite hard because if you think of the anti-involution campaign starts from last year, it's like the government has been using lots of the hard rules but instead of more of the softer measures such as like calling them into a meeting and talk them out of the price war.
segments.zh: 实际上很难，因为反内卷运动从去年开始，政府用了很多硬性规定，但更多的是软性措施，比如召集开会劝说他们退出价格战。

segments.en: But it has worked on some specific sectors like on the policy icon they had more specific rules but unlike some other sectors like food delivery you can see companies are still engaging in price war and over competing with each other because they are market share conversation considerations.
segments.zh: 但在某些特定行业有效，比如光伏有更具体的规定；而其他行业如外卖，公司仍在打价格战，过度竞争，因为要考虑市场份额。

segments.en: So like from the regulator perspective, the anti-involution campaign and the end of this price war is more of the sector to sector tailored measures. So because unlike previously on the over capacity on state on the sectors now this over capacity issues are happening in more private sectors and also on more like the immersion technology sector such as EV and solar panel.
segments.zh: 所以从监管者角度看，反内卷和结束价格战更多是行业量身定制的措施。因为与之前不同，产能过剩问题现在更多出现在私营部门和新兴技术领域，如电动汽车和太阳能板。

segments.en: So they don't want to get into hard on this companies but more of like finding out what are the problem matters through like tailored solutions for each industry specifically.
segments.zh: 所以他们不想对这些公司采取强硬手段，而是通过为每个行业量身定制解决方案来找出问题所在。
